goal: Create and inspect synthetic demo customer JevSteer QA UNIQUE-RUN
constraints: Demo company only. Create or edit only JevSteer QA UNIQUE-RUN. Do not create duplicates; inspect an existing match instead.
Do not send emails, invitations, payments or approvals.

success_criteria: Add Customer form is open with Name and Contact sections
guidance: Global New creates documents, not customers. Customer creation belongs to the plus (+) menu on the Customers list; that menu's Create only opens an empty Add Customer form and saves nothing.

milestones.goal: Fill the Add Customer form with name JevSteer QA UNIQUE-RUN and one contact whose email is jevsteer.qa.UNIQUE-RUN@example.invalid, without creating the customer
success_criteria: The Name field shows JevSteer QA UNIQUE-RUN
A contact entry shows the supplied email
The form is still open and Create has not been clicked
guidance: Customer email belongs to a Contact entry. Add in the Contact section only adds an unsaved contact row to this form. Create persists the customer; it belongs to the next milestone.

milestones.goal: Create customer JevSteer QA UNIQUE-RUN from the filled form
success_criteria: A saved customer row shows the exact name JevSteer QA UNIQUE-RUN
guidance: The form is already filled. Create persists the customer. If Create was already acknowledged, verify its outcome before retrying.

milestones.goal: The existing customer JevSteer QA UNIQUE-RUN details is open and its email matches the supplied email
success_criteria: The Name field shows JevSteer QA UNIQUE-RUN
The Email field shows the supplied email; ccMonet stores emails in lowercase, so compare it ignoring letter case
guidance: Saved customer details are editable and include a Save button; opening them without edits does not require saving.
